lines.text: Jesus, the apostle and high priest, was faithful to the One who appointed Him, just as Moses was faithful.
Jesus has greater glory than Moses, like a builder over a house, and Moses was faithful as a servant.
In the wilderness the fathers tested God and saw His works for seven years, so He swore they would never enter His rest.
The writer tells the brothers to exhort one another daily and to hold firmly to the end the assurance they had at first, so none is hardened.
Those who heard and rebelled were all those Joshua led out of Egypt, and unbelief kept them from entering.
